import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
# For the most recent year available (2015)
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df[['Country Group', 'Country Code', '2015 [YR2015]']]
per_capita_gdp = gni_per_capita_df[['Country Group', 'Country Code', '2015 [YR2015]']]
economic_output = exports_df[['Country Group', 'Country Code', '2015 [YR2015]']]

# Merge the datasets on 'Country Group' and 'Country Code'
merged_data = education_expenditure.merge(per_capita_gdp, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], how='inner')
merged_data = merged_data.merge(economic_output, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], how='inner')

# Rename columns for clarity
merged_data.columns = ['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Education_Expenditure', 'Per_Capita_GDP', 'Economic_Output']

# Display the first few rows of the merged dataset
merged_data.head()
